post.originalText:
Holly Cow. Just asked Opus 5.5 to do an explainer video of @DataGran . 

Prompt:
I Want you to make a modern slick and punchy video for https://t.co/NKld1dbPjU with an example of a user creating a chatgpt ads campaign, then connecting their metrics, understanding attribution, then connecting a voice agent to it, the agent responding, then doing follow up, adding humans in the loop and then providing analytics.

Datagran | Your Autonomous Growth Team


Your Autonomous Growth Team
Deploy an AI team that creates demand and converts it into revenue.
From the first ad to the final revenue answer, Datagran keeps every agent, system, and human working from the same context.
Book a demo (opens the booking calendar)Follow the journey
A 30-minute walkthrough, tailored to your business.
Human teamIn control



AI executes. Humans supervise. Datagran coordinates.


Human teamIn control



AI executes. Humans supervise. Datagran coordinates.





One continuous growth loop
Follow the signal from first impression to proven revenue.

01Create demand

Ads are created from what your brand and campaigns already know.
Datagran turns your Brand Book and past results into on-brand images, videos, and copy—then keeps learning from performance.
Fresh creative, without starting from zero.
02Qualify intent

Every lead gets an immediate, natural conversation.
Chat and voice agents answer questions, understand what each lead wants, and identify who is ready to move.
High-intent leads surface faster.
03Bring in your team

When a human is the better next step, the AI makes the handoff.
Your teammate receives the full conversation, the lead’s intent, where they came from, and what should happen next.
No repetition. No lost context.
04Keep systems current

The work is recorded while the conversation is still moving.
Datagran updates the CRM, creates the right tasks, and uploads documents so your systems match what actually happened.
Clean operations, without manual data entry.
05Close the loop

People always know what happens next.
The AI sends confirmations, reminders, and useful updates across the channels your customers already use.
A responsive experience from first touch to close.
06Measure revenue

Every touchpoint is tied back to the outcome.
Datagran connects paid media, chat, voice, CRM activity, and revenue to reveal which channels actually convert.
Attribution your team can trust.
07Ask your business

Now anyone can ask what is working—and get a clear answer.
Your company can chat with the AI to check conversions, ROI, pipeline, and the campaigns creating real growth.
One question away from the truth.

Why Datagran
The difference is continuity.
Most tools automate a task. Datagran carries the context through the entire customer journey, so every action makes the next one smarter.

01One memory across the journey
